scientific_question: Can a layerwise fixed atlas selected only from step-zero task geometry contain the later dense V and attention-cproj functional manifold at a one-percent coordinate budget, especially in late layers, without a learned basis, dense teacher-derived coordinates, or trainable dense optimizer state?

objective_scope.project_target: full generated attention replacement before any further model-size scaling or MLP replacement
objective_scope.accepted_parent: generated headwise Q/K plus dense V, dense attention cproj, and dense MLP

positive_observations: The one-percent affine BlockFHT chart can recover 0.80252 of held-out V exact-Muon action in aggregate, so the V tangent is not uniformly inaccessible.
The one-head quadratic decoder reaches held-out image recovery of 0.658, 0.850, and 0.717 for V in layers 0-2 and 0.810, 0.878, and 0.811 for attention cproj in layers 0-2.
Dense attention motion is overwhelmingly orientational: singular-value-changing coordinates contain below 0.3 percent of applied-direction energy.
negative_observations: The same affine chart fails disjoint state and local-chord transport and collapses in late layers.
Scalar activation, affine, residual-cubic, quadratic, Cayley, fixed FHT block-skew, ProductFHT, direct V/O coupling, and naive layer masking do not pass held-out full-attention gates.
Increasing attention-cproj latent ratio from 0.01 to 0.10 recovers only 0.0027 validation CE, ruling out a simple scalar capacity shortage.
The earlier MLP diagonal-KFAC output-pair selector was rejected; it changed pair ordering inside an existing chart and is not evidence for or against this full attention matrix-basis upper bound.
Literal Mapping Loss cannot enlarge a rejected decoder image and its alignment/smoothness terms are direction-inert for the tested affine BlockFHT chart.
causal_reconciliation.deduction: The next necessary-condition test must change how the fixed chart is oriented, not its scalar warp, polynomial degree, learning rate, or random coordinate count. The depth collapse requires layerwise task geometry rather than a uniform random atlas.

candidate_upper_bound.name: step-zero layerwise KFAC functional atlas
candidate_upper_bound.base: exact reconstructed GPT step-zero weights with zero latent displacement
candidate_upper_bound.basis_source: fixed calibration batches and CE forward/backward signals from the exact step-zero model only
construction: For every layer and target, collect the target's input-activation covariance and output-gradient covariance on two frozen calibration splits.
Eigendecompose the two covariance factors and rank Kronecker outer-product directions by the product of their eigenvalues.
Freeze the first round(P/100) matrix directions, where P is the target matrix size; coordinates alone vary thereafter.
Use separate layerwise atlases for V and attention cproj. V is scored after attention mixing and the dense terminal O functional metric; cproj is scored as H times the candidate displacement.
The dense Kronecker atlas is an optimistic representability upper bound. It is not a deployable decoder; a pass only permits a later structured approximation gate.
candidate_upper_bound.why_not_lora: No basis vector is optimized and no dense or low-rank residual is trained. The basis is a frozen step-zero diagnostic. Nevertheless, its dense fixed storage is explicitly counted, so it cannot itself be claimed as an efficient final Mapping Network.

controls: isotropic random Kronecker directions at the identical coordinate count
evaluations: dense fixed-basis storage and projected materialization cost

decision_rule.pass: Authorize implementation of a fixed structured approximation to the atlas plus an offline approximation gate. Do not authorize language-model training or scaling.
decision_rule.fail: Conclude that a one-percent fixed step-zero atlas is not sufficient for generated V/O. Before full replacement can continue, explicitly relax at least one constraint: permit an adaptive/learned basis, increase coordinate budget with a new cost target, or change the functional factorization. Do not launch another random fixed-chart sweep.

execution_policy.monitoring: foreground polling; no watchdog or callbacks

identity_inputs_to_pin_in_executable_pla: exact dense config and source commit
dataset manifest and four frozen batch digests
